data.name: Help.AdvancedSearch
data.value: Choose file types, sizes, and locations to build a search query automatically. Find large videos or archives without learning search syntax.

data.name: Help.ApplySearch
data.value: Apply these conditions, search, and visualize the matching files. If unavailable, correct the input error shown in this window. Windows exclusion also applies to the main window.

data.name: Help.Back
data.value: Return to the folder you previously viewed, rather than the parent folder. Available after visiting another folder. Shortcut: Alt+Left Arrow.

data.name: Help.Breadcrumb
data.value: Click to go straight to this folder. Click an earlier folder name to move up several levels at once.

data.name: Help.BrowseSearchFolder
data.value: Choose a folder and fill in its path. This only sets the search location; use ‘Search and visualize’ to run the search.

data.name: Help.CancelScan
data.value: Stop the current analysis or search without changing files. Choose a drive or folder, or refresh, to start again.

data.name: Help.CancelSearch
data.value: Close without applying these conditions. The current results and settings are kept.

data.name: Help.ChooseDrive
data.value: Click to analyze all file sizes on this drive. The free space and total capacity below describe the drive itself.

data.name: Help.ChooseFolder
data.value: Choose a folder to analyze, including all its subfolders. Use this to examine a smaller location than an entire drive.

data.name: Help.CopyPath
data.value: Copy this item's full path. Paste it into a text editor or File Explorer's address bar.

data.name: Help.CopySelection
data.value: Copy the selected item's full path, or the current folder's path if nothing is selected. Paste it into a text editor or File Explorer's address bar.

data.name: Help.Counts
data.value: The total numbers of files and folders below the current folder. In search mode, this shows matching files.

data.name: Help.DepthOne
data.value: Show the current folder's items as large rectangles without nested previews. Use this for a simpler view. Click a folder to explore its contents.

data.name: Help.DepthThree
data.value: Show two additional subfolder levels inside each folder rectangle. Compare several levels at once and click a visible subfolder directly. Very small items may be grouped or omitted from the preview.

data.name: Help.DepthTwo
data.value: Show one additional subfolder level inside each folder rectangle. Compare which subfolders are largest and click a displayed subfolder to go straight to it.

data.name: Help.Details
data.value: Show or hide the current folder's file and folder list. Find tiny items and 0 B files that cannot be seen in the treemap. Click folders to navigate; right-click items for actions. Shortcut: F9.

data.name: Help.ExcludeWindows
data.value: Exclude C:\Windows and everything inside it from the view, search results, and size totals. Useful for examining your own files without system files. Changing this option reanalyzes the location without deleting anything.

data.name: Help.ExplorerMenu
data.value: Add or remove this app in File Explorer's folder context menu. Once registered, you can start analyzing a folder directly from File Explorer.

data.name: Help.ExplorerState
data.value: The registration status of the File Explorer context menu. If you moved the app, choose Update registration to this location.

data.name: Help.Extensions
data.value: Choose the kinds of files to find, such as zip for archives or mp4 for videos. Separate multiple extensions with semicolons, e.g. zip;7z. * means all file types.

data.name: Help.FileTile
data.value: Click: select file · Right-click: open file, show in Explorer, copy path, or properties

data.name: Help.FolderTile
data.value: Click: go straight to this folder · Right-click: show in Explorer, open, copy path, or properties

data.name: Help.FullScreen
data.value: Expand the treemap to fill your monitor and inspect small items. Press F11 to toggle, or Esc while in fullscreen to return to the original window.

data.name: Help.GroupTile
data.value: Very small items are grouped together. Click to inspect individual items in the list.

data.name: Help.ListResize
data.value: Drag left or right to adjust the widths of the treemap and the item list.

data.name: Help.LiveUpdates
data.value: Automatically refresh the view when files are added, removed, or resized. Search results refresh every 5 seconds. Turning this off pauses automatic updates. Use Refresh to check immediately.

data.name: Help.NameFilter
data.value: Show only items whose names contain this text within the current folder. In search mode, narrow the current results by name. This does not start a new computer-wide search. Clear the text to show all items again.

data.name: Help.OpenFile
data.value: Open this file using the default program assigned in Windows.

data.name: Help.OpenFolder
data.value: Open this folder in File Explorer. To explore its size inside this app, click the folder in the treemap.

data.name: Help.Properties
data.value: Open Windows Properties to inspect this item's type, size, dates, and other details.

data.name: Help.QueryPreview
data.value: The Everything query generated from your choices. You do not need to write it yourself. Use Search and visualize to apply it, or copy it for later.

data.name: Help.Refresh
data.value: Read the latest sizes for the selected drive, folder, or current search results. Use this when changes have not appeared yet. Shortcut: F5.

data.name: Help.RegisterExplorer
data.value: Register this app so you can analyze a folder by right-clicking the folder or its background. Applies only to the current Windows user. On Windows 11, it may appear under Show more options.

data.name: Help.Reveal
data.value: Locate this item in Windows File Explorer.

data.name: Help.RevealSelection
data.value: Locate the selected item in Windows File Explorer. If nothing is selected, locate the current folder instead.

data.name: Help.RunSearch
data.value: Find files matching the entered query and show rectangles proportional to their sizes. The search is not limited to the selected drive. Use Advanced search to choose a search location.

data.name: Help.ScanTime
data.value: The time taken by the most recent full analysis or search. This is not the time to open the current folder or the automatic saving interval.

data.name: Help.SearchDrive
data.value: Search only this drive and its contents. For example, choosing C:\ excludes files on other drives from the results.

data.name: Help.SearchFolder
data.value: Search only this folder and all its subfolders. Enter the full path or use Choose folder to select it.

data.name: Help.SearchQuery
data.value: Find files throughout Everything's indexed locations. Example: *.zip size:>500mb → ZIP files larger than 500 MB. Use Advanced search if you prefer choosing conditions. Press Enter to search or Ctrl+E to focus this box.

data.name: Help.SearchScope
data.value: Choose where to find files: all indexed locations, one drive, or a folder and its subfolders. Choose a relevant folder to narrow the results.

data.name: Help.Size
data.value: Total file sizes in the current folder and all its subfolders. In search mode, only matching files are included. This can differ from the drive's used space.

data.name: Help.SizeComparison
data.value: Choose how to compare file sizes. Greater than excludes the exact size; At least includes it. No size limit ignores the size condition.

data.name: Help.SizeUnit
data.value: The unit for the entered size. KB or MB are common for documents; GB is useful for large videos. For example, size 500 with unit MB means 500 MB. Unused when No size limit is selected.

data.name: Help.SizeValue
data.value: Enter a size for one file, such as 500 or 1.5, and select the unit beside it. If this box is disabled, choose a size condition such as Greater than or At least first.

data.name: Help.UnregisterExplorer
data.value: Remove only this app's File Explorer context menu. The app and analyzed files are kept. Unavailable if the menu has not been registered.

data.name: Help.Up
data.value: Go up one level to the folder containing the current folder. You cannot go outside the original analysis root. Shortcut: Backspace.

data.name: Language.Tooltip
data.value: Language / Change the interface language. Your choice is saved.

data.name: Service.ApprovalRequired
data.value: Administrator approval is required once to install or start the Everything indexing service. Run Setup again and approve the Windows prompt.

data.name: Service.EmptyIndex
data.value: Everything answered, but its file index is empty. Check that the indexing service is running and the target drive is included.

data.name: Service.RepairFailed
data.value: The Everything indexing service could not be prepared. Run Setup again and approve the administrator prompt. Details: %LOCALAPPDATA%\DiskSpaceAnalyzer\EverythingServiceRepair.log

data.name: Service.Repairing
data.value: Setting up the Everything indexing service. Approve the Windows administrator prompt to continue.

data.name: Service.RestartFailed
data.value: Everything could not be restarted while repairing its indexing service. Close Everything and run Setup again.
